description: This Java interface defines a builder pattern for creating instances of MappingContext with a fluent API. It includes methods to set various configuration options such as the mapping engine, options as a JSON object, incoming and outgoing conditions, and a build method to create the MappingContext object.

classes.name: MappingContextBuilder
classes.description: An interface that provides a fluent API for constructing MappingContext instances, allowing configuration of the mapping engine, options, and message conditions.

methods.name: mappingEngine
methods.description: Sets the MappingEngine for the context being built, identified by its name.

methods.name: options
methods.description: Sets the options for the mapper as a JsonObject.

methods.name: incomingConditions
methods.description: Defines conditions for mapping incoming messages, represented as a Map of String to String.

methods.name: outgoingConditions
methods.description: Defines conditions for mapping outgoing messages, represented as a Map of String to String.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns the configured MappingContext instance.
